process_area.title: Construction Finance Product, Lender Network & Brokerage Setup

value_stream.name: Home Construction Finance, Loan Brokerage & Mortgage Referral Services

fields.Participants: Merchandising (VS-01), Trade (VS-11), Project Design (VS-66), Insights (VS-44), Legal (VS-100.3)

Automation Opportunity: - Opportunity-sizing analytics; product-portfolio modeling; charter-compliance check
Controls: - CTL-692 (ensure controlled execution — Construction Finance Product, Lender Network & Brokerage Setup (PA-154.1).)
- CTL-692: strategy brokerage-only (legal-validated VS-100.3); insight-sized; board-approved (VS-36)
Cross-references: - links to VS-33 (strategy), VS-44 (insights), VS-11/VS-66 (trade/project), VS-100.3 (legal), W4554 (lenders), W4555 (licensing)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Charter-overstep risk**: BuildRight inadvertently lending (regulatory); mitigated by strict brokerage model & legal validation
- **Mis-sized-product risk**: Products customers don't want; mitigated by insight-driven sizing

steps.activity: Finance Strategy/Commercial set the construction-finance strategy (brokerage/referral, not lending), product portfolio (construction loan, home-equity/renovation, Pag-IBIG end-user, bank housing loan, B2B contractor financing), and target segments
Finance Strategy/Insights size the opportunity (financing-constrained demand, basket-lift, conversion, referral revenue) using VS-44/VS-13 data, and define success metrics
Finance Strategy/Legal validate the strategy within BuildRight's retail charter (no deposit-taking/lending; brokerage/accreditation model) and obtain board approval (VS-36)

fields.Volume: Lender partner network (universal/thrift banks, Pag-IBIG, financing companies)

workflows.name: Lender/Partner Network Development (Banks, Pag-IBIG, Financing Companies)

Controls: - CTL-692 (ensure controlled execution — Construction Finance Product, Lender Network & Brokerage Setup (PA-154.1).)
- CTL-692: lenders BSP-licensed/solvent (VS-22); partners DD'd (VS-34); portfolio diversified; conduct monitored (VS-67)
Cross-references: - links to VS-34/VS-03 (DD), VS-100.3 (legal), VS-22 (compliance), VS-67 (scorecard), W4553 (strategy), W4570 (commission)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Partner-solvency risk**: Lender fails mid-program → stranded customers; mitigated by BSP-licensed/solvent screening
- **Partner-concentration risk**: Over-reliance on one lender; mitigated by portfolio diversification
System Touchpoints: - Procurement/DD (VS-34/VS-03); legal (VS-100.3); compliance (VS-22); risk (VS-21.2); vendor scorecard (VS-67)
Time Estimate: - Per partner ~4–8 weeks; ongoing portfolio mgmt

steps.activity: Commercial/Finance Strategy build the lender-partner network (banks for housing loans, Pag-IBIG for end-user financing, financing companies for contractor/renovation loans), screened for BSP-licensure/solvency
Commercial/Legal negotiate partnership/MOU (referral terms, commission W4570, data exchange, SLA, branding), with due diligence (VS-34/VS-03) and compliance (VS-22)
Commercial/Risk manage the partner portfolio (performance, solvency, conduct), renew/exit (VS-67), and ensure competitive coverage across regions/segments

fields.Volume: Brokerage accreditation/licensing across the lender network

Controls: - CTL-692: brokerage properly accredited (VS-100.3/VS-22); disclosure compliant; commission tax-treated (VS-79)
Cross-references: - links to VS-100.3 (legal), VS-22 (compliance), VS-79 (tax), VS-17 (finance), W4554 (partners), W4570 (commission)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unlicensed-activity risk**: Soliciting loans without proper accreditation → BSP/regulatory action; mitigated by accreditation & legal scope
- **Disclosure-failure risk**: Inadequate fee/commission disclosure; mitigated by consumer-protection-compliant disclosure (VS-22)

steps.activity: Legal/Compliance determine BuildRight's brokerage/accreditation status (accredited real-estate/marketing partner, loan-soliciting agent where BSP rules allow), and secure any required registrations/accreditations
Legal/Commercial execute brokerage/referral agreements with each lender (scope, commission, compliance obligations, data/privacy, liability), per VS-100.3
Compliance/Tax manage ongoing brokerage compliance (BSP consumer-protection, disclosure, tax on commission VS-79) and the accreditation lifecycle

fields.Trigger: Product design (W4553); lender term change; review
fields.Volume: Loan-product terms/eligibility framework across the portfolio

workflows.name: Loan Product Terms, Eligibility & Pricing Framework

Automation Opportunity: - Product-term/eligibility rules engine; offer-bundle configuration; compliance-disclosure generation
Controls: - CTL-692 (ensure controlled execution — Construction Finance Product, Lender Network & Brokerage Setup (PA-154.1).)
- CTL-692: terms insight-fit; eligibility non-discriminatory & documented; disclosure compliant (VS-22/VS-100.3)
Cross-references: - links to VS-01.2 (pricing), VS-38 (consumer credit), VS-44 (insights), VS-22/VS-100.3 (compliance/legal), W4553 (strategy), W4557 (risk)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Misaligned-terms risk**: Terms don't fit BuildRight's customer/project profile; mitigated by insight-driven design
- **Discrimination risk**: Eligibility bias → consumer-protection exposure; mitigated by non-discriminatory, documented criteria
System Touchpoints: - Pricing (VS-01.2); consumer credit (VS-38); insights (VS-44); trade (VS-11); compliance/legal (VS-22/VS-100.3)

steps.activity: Finance Strategy/Lenders define product terms (loan amount, tenor, rate range, collateral, fees) and eligibility (income, credit, property, project scope) per product, aligned to lender criteria
Commercial/Insights set the BuildRight customer offer (bundled materials/services, preferential terms via partner, project-size thresholds) and pricing linkage (VS-01.2/VS-38)
Legal/Compliance ensure terms/eligibility are non-discriminatory, clearly disclosed, and consumer-protection-compliant (RA 7394/BSP), per VS-22/VS-100.3

Automation Opportunity: - Suitability/pre-qualification scoring; predatory-term detector; complaint-pattern analytics
Controls: - CTL-692: anti-predatory standard enforced; BuildRight pre-qualifies (lender underwrites); suitability monitored (VS-13); board-reported (VS-36)
Cross-references: - links to VS-21.2 (ERM), VS-22 (compliance), VS-100.3 (legal), VS-13 (complaints), VS-21 (audit), W4556 (terms)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Predatory-partner risk**: BuildRight steers customers to harmful loans → consumer/regulatory/reputational harm; mitigated by anti-predatory standard & partner screening
- **Suitability-mismatch risk**: Wrong product for the customer; mitigated by suitability guidance & complaint monitoring
System Touchpoints: - ERM (VS-21.2); compliance (VS-22); legal (VS-100.3); customer complaints (VS-13); audit (VS-21)

steps.a: Head of Internal Audit & Risk / CFO
steps.activity: Risk/Finance Strategy define BuildRight's credit-policy role (pre-qualification scoring guidance, referral criteria, NOT underwriting — that's the lender's) and risk appetite, per VS-21.2

steps.a: VP Legal / Head of Internal Audit & Risk
steps.activity: Compliance/Legal set the anti-predatory-lending standard (no usurious/predatory partner products, fair terms, suitability, no steering to harmful products), per BSP/RA 7394
Audit/Compliance monitor referrals for suitability/fairness, manage complaints (VS-13), and report risk/compliance to the board (VS-36)

Automation Opportunity: - Milestone→draw→invoice integration; progress-confirmation app; cash-flow timing analytics
Controls: - CTL-692 (ensure controlled execution — Construction Finance Product, Lender Network & Brokerage Setup (PA-154.1).)
- CTL-692: draw-schedule milestone-aligned (VS-66/VS-12); billing timed to draws (no BuildRight customer financing); integration reconciled
Cross-references: - links to VS-66 (project design), VS-12 (install), VS-27/W4560 (integration), VS-18 (treasury), VS-11 (trade), W4568 (disbursement)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Draw-billing-mismatch risk**: BuildRight bills before draw releases → working-capital strain (VS-18); mitigated by milestone-aligned billing
- **Milestone-dispute risk**: Lender/contractor disagree on completion → draw delay; mitigated by clear milestone/scope definition (VS-66)
System Touchpoints: - Project design (VS-66); install (VS-12); IT integration (VS-27/W4560); treasury (VS-18); trade (VS-11)

steps.activity: Finance Strategy/Project Design designs the construction draw-schedule (milestone-based releases tied to VS-66 project stages & VS-12 install progress), aligning BuildRight material/service billing to draws
Lenders/Finance Strategy/IT integrate BuildRight↔lender (milestone confirmation → draw release → BuildRight invoice settlement), per VS-27/W4560
Treasury/Finance manage the cash-flow timing (material procured before draw released) and working-capital impact, ensuring BuildRight isn't financing the customer's build (VS-18)

fields.Owner: Commercial / Store Ops (VS-07) / Trade (VS-11) / Sales Enablement (VS-124)
fields.Participants: Field Sales (VS-140), L&D (VS-19.4), Marketing (VS-14), Project Design (VS-66)
fields.Volume: Frontline offer across 200 stores + trade/B2B channel

workflows.name: Frontline Enablement — Finance Desk, Store & Trade-Channel Offer

Automation Opportunity: - Customer-journey/referral app; frontline enablement content; uptake analytics
Controls: - CTL-692 (ensure controlled execution — Construction Finance Product, Lender Network & Brokerage Setup (PA-154.1).)
- CTL-692: frontline trained (no misleading promises VS-22); referral compliant; offer uptake monitored
Cross-references: - links to VS-07 (stores), VS-11 (trade), VS-140 (field sales), VS-124/VS-19.4 (enablement/L&D), VS-14 (marketing), VS-134 (OCM), W4570 (commission)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Mis-selling risk**: Frontline over-promises financing (approval/rate); mitigated by training & compliance (no binding promises)
- **Low-referral risk**: Frontline doesn't offer → no uptake; mitigated by incentives (W4570) & enablement
System Touchpoints: - Store ops (VS-07); trade (VS-11); field sales (VS-140); sales enablement (VS-124); L&D (VS-19.4); marketing (VS-14); OCM (VS-134)

steps.activity: Commercial/Sales Enablement design the finance-desk model (in-store finance desk, trade-channel offer, field-sales referral VS-140) and the customer journey (identify → qualify → refer → close)
L&D/Sales Enablement train frontline (when/how to offer financing, pre-qualification, handoff, compliance — no misleading promises) via VS-19.4/VS-124
Marketing/Commercial launch the offer (campaign VS-14, trade program VS-43, loyalty tie VS-13), with OCM adoption (VS-134), and monitor uptake

Automation Opportunity: - Application/scoring automation; secure lender API; analytics dashboards
Controls: - CTL-692 (ensure controlled execution — Construction Finance Product, Lender Network & Brokerage Setup (PA-154.1).)
- CTL-692: architecture EA-governed (VS-113); data RA 10173-compliant & secured (VS-91/VS-27.3); analytics governed (VS-28)
Cross-references: - links to VS-27/VS-113 (IT/EA), VS-28 (data), VS-27.3/VS-91 (security/privacy), W4558 (integration), W4575 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Privacy-breach risk**: Customer financial data exposed; mitigated by RA 10173 consent & security (VS-91/VS-27.3)
- **Integration-failure risk**: Lender data exchange breaks → stalled applications; mitigated by robust integration & monitoring
System Touchpoints: - IT/EA (VS-27/VS-113); data (VS-28); security (VS-27.3); privacy (VS-91); lender integration (W4558)

steps.activity: IT/EA/Finance Strategy design the systems architecture (customer application, pre-qualification scoring, lender integration, draw-milestone tracking, commission), per VS-113
Privacy/Security ensure customer financial-data privacy (consent, purpose-limit, secure lender exchange) per RA 10173 (VS-91) and security (VS-27.3)
Data/Finance Strategy build referral/loan analytics (conversion, basket-lift, referral revenue, default correlation) on the platform (VS-28), with data governance
